instruction: Look up the most recent open pull request in "cli/cli" that has the label "external", then write it in the format "#<number> | <labels> | <title>" to the file "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_prs_3_4.txt". If there is no pull request that matches, save the file as empty.
reference_command: gh pr list --repo cli/cli --search 'label:"external" sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title,labels --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) | \(([.labels[].name] | if length == 0 then "none" else join(",") end)) | \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_prs_3_4.txt"
